title: Street Origins Cape Town Dream Eau de Parfum 75ml

  • Size: 75ml
  • Scent profile: Fresh · Citrus · Aquatic
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • A crisp opening of apple, bergamot and grapefruit
  • A bright heart of orange blossom
  • A breezy base of patchouli, amber and sea notes
  • Fresh and easy to wear every day

Apple, bergamot and grapefruit first, then orange blossom, finishing with patchouli, amber and sea notes.
